criterion: Recovery: do not offer actions that cannot succeed
description: After a re-pair, an Unknown-outcome execution still offers 'Retry with the same request', which always fails with 409 CREDENTIAL_CHANGED. Re-pairing while such work exists gives no warning that it strands that work, because the header caution appears only when the credential is expiring.
expected: Before re-pairing: "1 request may already be in T3; after re-pairing it can only be abandoned." Afterwards: Retry hidden or disabled with that reason.
actual: Pair again succeeds silently. Retry is offered, and its refusal appears off-screen for about 2 s.
suggested_fix: Expose 'retryable' per execution in the snapshot (credential matches), disable Retry with an explanation, and confirm Pair again when unresolved submissions exist.

description: 'Look for this request in T3' gives no visible feedback when the result is unchanged. The automatic lookup had already written 'Last lookup: No T3 record…', and a manual lookup re-renders the same line, with no timestamp.
expected: 'Last lookup 14:05:12: no T3 record…', with the time updating on each lookup, and a busy state while it runs.
actual: An identical card before and after the click.
suggested_fix: Store and show the lookup time, and show 'Looking…' while the request is in flight.

description: After a successful retry, the Running card still shows 'Last lookup: No T3 record of this request; absence does not prove non-acceptance', and its freshness shows 'Not read from T3 yet' in amber.
expected: Lookup notes are cleared once the run is established, and a neutral 'Reading…' for a run that has just started.
actual: A running run carries a 'no record' note and a warning-coloured freshness label.
suggested_fix: Hide lastLookup when runId is set, and use a neutral colour for the not-yet-read state of a run that has just started.

description: 'Retry with the same request' and 'Abandon this outcome' are identical full-width grey buttons sharing one evidence field. Nothing shows which is irreversible.
expected: Retry as the primary action, and Abandon as secondary or danger with a one-line consequence ("No verdict can be recorded afterwards").
suggested_fix: Style them differently and add a consequence hint under Abandon.
